# NudgePhase

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The phase of equilibrium propagation where target outputs weakly perturb the network to produce a learning signal distinct from the free phase. It is central to local, backprop-free credit assignment in TCC and iNEST architectures.
